bio: Pitu Guli was a Macedonian revolutionary of Vlach descent from Kruševo and a voivode of the organisation. When Ottoman forces marched on the Kruševo Republic in August 1903, he and his men held the position of Mečkin Kamen above the town and fought to the last. He died there, and Mečkin Kamen became a symbol of the Ilinden Uprising, sung about in the Macedonian anthem.
